arxiv.title: CARTA: Self-Supervised Reusable Transaction Embeddings via Heterogeneous Tokenization and Cross-Attention
arxiv.abstract: Acquiring fraud labels for payment transactions is expensive and inconsistent across tasks, and high-cardinality identifiers such as merchant names make one-hot feature pipelines infeasible at scale. We present CARTA, a self-supervised encoder that learns a compact 16-dim embedding from raw transactions without labels; the frozen embedding is then reused for label-efficient fraud probing and exploratory unsupervised risk stratification without retraining the encoder. CARTA uses type-specific projections with learned embedding tables for high-cardinality identifiers, trained with token excision and InfoNCE contrastive loss. On IEEE-CIS, its linear probe at 1% of labels exceeds a raw-feature probe at 100%; on IBM TabFormer (2M rows), its frozen embedding reaches GBDT AUPRC 0.508, above frequency encoding (0.411) and the merchant-dropping baseline (0.022), though fully-supervised CatBoost is stronger. CARTA is a label-free, reusable representation that complements task-specific supervised models.

arxiv.title: How Well Can LLMs Verbalize Mathematical Formulas? A Multi-Domain Evaluation
arxiv.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities across natural language tasks. But their ability to generate accurate written verbalizations of mathematical formulas has not been systematically evaluated. Such verbalization is important for text-to-speech systems supporting audio-based learning and visually impaired users. We evaluated five state-of-the-art LLMs across six scientific domains and constructed Read-Aloud Math, a balanced multi-domain corpus with LaTeX formulas, manually validated simple and extended transcriptions, multiple variants, textual context, domain labels, and formula complexity levels. Using multi-reference BLEU, GPT-5.2 achieved the highest score for simple transcriptions (75.9% without context, 64.9% with context), although without context it did not significantly outperform Grok 4.1 Fast or Claude Sonnet 4.5. Claude Sonnet 4.5 achieved the highest score for extended transcriptions without context (36.5%), and Grok 4.1 Fast with context (48.8%). For extended transcriptions, Statistics and Mathematics scored highest across the two context settings, while Physics scored lowest. Formula length was significantly negatively associated with BLEU for simple transcriptions without context, but not with context, whereas BLEU increased significantly with formula length for extended transcriptions in both settings. Grouping symbols were most frequently involved in transcription differences, while variable names, capitalization, and Greek letters were associated with lower BLEU scores. Overall, LLM-based formula verbalization is promising but remains sensitive to transcription type, textual context, and formula characteristics.

arxiv.title: Arctic-SWE: Revisiting the Long Horizon Agent Training by Modeling-System Co-Design
arxiv.abstract: Long-horizon agent training, including software engineering, is advancing rapidly, but the recipe and infrastructure needed for a strong reinforcement-learning baseline remain difficult to reproduce. This makes gains from new algorithms or data hard to distinguish from improvements to an under-tuned baseline. We present Arctic-SWE, a fully asynchronous RL framework that establishes such a baseline through model-system co-design, using overfitting on a small task pool as the testbed. This testbed exposes failures that early reward gains conceal and guides the integration of established components: gated reward, importance-weight control, aligned training and inference engines, and consistent state across policy updates. No single component is new, yet together they form the missing foundation. On raw R2E-Gym data, without new algorithms or data work, Arctic-SWE trains Qwen3.5-4B to 62.0% pass@1 on SWE-bench Verified. This is comparable to concurrent FrogNano (61.5%), which relies on online task synthesis, after about one-sixth as many training rollouts. Building on this foundation, we further filter and refine R2E-Gym, SWE-rebench V2, and Scale-SWE. With this curated subset, the 4B model improves from 47.4%/25.0%/37.9% to 65.0%/38.3%/59.7% on SWE-bench Verified/Pro-v1/Pro-v2, and the recipe also improves Qwen3.5-9B from 56.2%/31.9%/48.8% to 65.7%/39.6%/70.2% on Verified/Pro-v1/Pro-v2. Controlled comparisons show that both curation and test strengthening improve held-out performance, although stronger tests reduce apparent training-task mastery. Arctic-SWE provides a documented starting point for studying better algorithms, data and environments for asynchronous agent RL.

arxiv.title: A Cross-Domain Evaluation of Prompting Techniques for Large Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Prompt engineering has become a central mechanism for guiding the behavior of Large Language Models (LLMs) across a wide range of reasoning and language understanding tasks [1], [2]. However, existing studies frequently evaluate prompting techniques using different LLMs, datasets, or task settings, making direct comparisons across methods and domains difficult [3]. Consequently, in this paper we present a controlled cross-domain evaluation of Zero-Shot prompting, Few-Shot prompting, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and automatic prompt optimization based on a PE2-inspired optimization pipeline [4]-[6]. All experiments were conducted with the same LLM and evaluated on six benchmark datasets covering arithmetic reasoning, logical reasoning, commonsense reasoning, and factual verification. The results show that no prompting strategy consistently outperforms the others across all domains, and pairwise statistical comparisons of the highest-performing configurations revealed no significant differences. RAG achieves the highest overall average accuracy of 78.33% when 300 examples are available for retrieval, while Few-Shot Prompting achieves comparatively high accuracies across several structured reasoning tasks. Zero-Shot Prompting remains competitive on tasks with self-contained inputs, whereas the PE2-inspired optimization approach produces stable but not systematically superior results compared to the other evaluated prompting techniques. Furthermore, increasing the number of task-specific examples does not consistently improve performance across prompting techniques, indicating strong domain and task dependency. These findings suggest that prompting techniques should be selected adaptively based on task characteristics rather than treated as universally applicable optimization strategies.

arxiv.title: A Symmetry-Matching Approach to Blind-Spot Reduction in Sparse Autoencoders
arxiv.abstract: Language models can treat semantically distinct inputs as interchangeable at the representation level, creating blind spots that standard sparse autoencoder (SAE) objectives do not target. In safety-critical settings such as clinical dosage extraction, legal clause interpretation, or financial amount verification, such failures can propagate silently into downstream decisions. We study this problem as one of feature-basis orientation. Building on a symmetry-matching view from algebraic error-detection theory, we add a differentiable $V_{\mathrm{Gini}}$ regularisation term to SAE training that penalises uneven perturbation response within a specified family. Across GPT-2, Gemma 2, and Qwen 2.5, a frozen multi-seed evaluation shows that $V$-regularisation raises both relative and absolute lower-tail responses while reducing response-profile imbalance, with no material general-text reconstruction degradation. JumpReLU and minimum description length (MDL) objectives remain close to the Standard SAE profile under the same protocol. Family-geometry controls show that the effect is not explained by template duplication or a single dominant perturbation family, and held-out probes plus null-calibrated separation tests evaluate how far the representation-level change carries to downstream discriminability. A zero-shot audit on out-of-distribution clinical radiology minimal pairs finds the relative weak-tail lift in all evaluated model-by-family cells, not perfectly rank-aligned with the trained statistic, and a held-out family audit finds it on family kinds never used in training. Together, the results show that perturbation-aware SAE training can reorient feature bases toward safety-relevant input changes while leaving downstream validation as a separate empirical step.

arxiv.titleZh: 一种对称匹配方法减少稀疏自编码器的盲点
arxiv.summaryZh: 标准SAE目标不针对语义不同却在表征层被视作可互换的输入，此类盲点在临床剂量、法律条款等安全场景中会静默传播。方法把问题视为特征基取向，借鉴代数检错中的对称匹配视角，在SAE训练中加入可微V_Gini正则，惩罚指定扰动族内不均匀响应。在GPT-2、Gemma 2、Qwen 2.5的冻结多种子评测中，该正则提升下尾响应的相对与绝对值、降低响应轮廓不均衡，通用文本重构无明显退化。分布外临床影像最小对的零样本审计在所有模型—扰动族单元均见弱尾提升，表明扰动感知的SAE训练可把特征基转向安全相关输入变化，下游可判别性仍需单独验证。

arxiv.title: Compositional Activation Steering Across Languages and Behaviors with Contextual Gates
arxiv.abstract: Activation steering has emerged as an effective and precise way to influence the behaviours of language models. However, composing multiple steering directions to control several behaviours simultaneously remains challenging, particularly in multilingual settings and with training-free steering vectors. We address this challenge with contextual steering, jointly training gates that adapt the strength of fixed steering directions to the current hidden state and interactions between interventions. Across a broad range of languages, behavioural attributes, and models, our approach outperforms constant-strength steering and four strong baselines, including prompting. It also better preserves general knowledge and keeps the model's internal computation closer to that of the prompted model. Our analysis further shows how jointly trained gates adapt their contributions during composition, explaining the mechanisms underlying effective compositional steering.
arxiv.titleZh: 跨语言与多行为的组合式激活引导：上下文门控方法
arxiv.summaryZh: 激活引导能精确调控语言模型行为，但将多个引导方向组合起来同时控制多种行为仍很困难，多语言场景与免训练引导向量下尤甚。方法为上下文引导：联合训练门控，依据当前隐藏状态及各干预之间的交互，自适应调整固定引导方向的强度。在多种语言、行为属性和模型上，该方法优于恒定强度引导和包括prompting在内的四个强基线，并更好地保留通用知识，使模型内部计算更接近prompted模型。分析显示联合训练的门控在组合时会调整各自贡献，解释了有效组合式引导的机制。

arxiv.title: HybridResearcher: Bridging the Structured-Unstructured Boundary for Deep Research Agents
arxiv.abstract: While LLM agents are increasingly capable of gathering and synthesizing evidence from a single homogeneous source, such as structured tables or unstructured data, real-world analytical questions frequently span heterogeneous sources. For example, answering one enterprise question may require both a result computed over an internal database and evidence found on the web. Recent evaluations on benchmarks like HybridDeepResearch show that even frontier agents struggle when evidence must cross this boundary. While these benchmarks have exposed the limitation, methodologies to explicitly teach cross-source reasoning remain absent. To address this, we introduce HybridResearcher, a 4B agent trained to bridge evidence across the structured and unstructured boundary. To build it, we synthesize cross-source bridge trajectories by starting with validated single-source tasks-such as existing text-to-SQL or web search queries-and fabricating the missing source around a bridge entity drawn from the seed's own output. We retain a sample only when strict construction gates confirm that neither side alone suffices, ensuring the data requires true cross-source interdependence. Finally, we train on this curated dataset using supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning. Evaluated on the existing HybridDeepResearch benchmark, HybridResearcher improves over our base model, Qwen3.5-4B, by 30.0 points pass@8 and surpasses the far larger Qwen3.5-397B-A17B by 8.3 points, while also improving over its base model on established, held-out single-source benchmarks (BrowseComp and BrowseComp-Plus), demonstrating that this complex cross-source reasoning can be taught directly to small models without triggering catastrophic forgetting.
arxiv.titleZh: HybridResearcher：打通深度研究智能体的结构化与非结构化边界

arxiv.title: Distribution-Based Regularization for Reward Fine-Tuning Diffusion and Flow Models
arxiv.abstract: Reward fine-tuning is an effective way to adapt pretrained diffusion and flow-matching models to downstream objectives, but aggressive optimization often leads to mode collapse and distributional drift. Existing methods attempt to control this drift with reverse-KL regularization, implemented as an $\ell_2$ penalty on the velocity field; however, this functions by indirectly constraining sampling dynamics rather than directly acting on the generated distribution. To address this, we propose DFR (Distributional Functional Rewards), which augments the task reward with a distribution-dependent, per-sample reward that acts explicitly on the generated distribution. Formally, we generalize the KL-regularized objective from expected rewards, which are linear in the model's distribution, to convex functionals of it. The first variation of this objective defines an effective, distribution-dependent reward that directly penalizes deviation from the pretrained distribution. This formulation yields additive per-sample rewards for the Fréchet distance (FD), maximum mean discrepancy (MMD), and DreamSim diversity, recovering several recently proposed rewards as special cases. Across various text-to-image fine-tuning tasks, DFR matches the peak reward of KL-tuned baselines while increasing diversity by up to 29% at equal or lower drift.

arxiv.titleZh: 面向扩散与流模型的基于分布的正则化奖励微调
arxiv.summaryZh: 奖励微调能把预训练的扩散与流匹配模型适配到下游目标，但激进优化常导致模式坍缩与分布漂移;现有做法用 reverse-KL 正则，以对速度场的 ℓ2 惩罚间接约束采样动态，并未直接作用于生成分布。DFR 把 KL 正则目标从对分布线性的期望奖励推广到分布的凸泛函，用其一阶变分定义依赖分布的单样本有效奖励，对 Fréchet 距离、MMD 与 DreamSim 多样性均可导出可加的单样本奖励，并将若干近期奖励形式收为特例。在多个文生图微调任务上，DFR 达到 KL 调参基线的峰值奖励，同等或更低漂移下多样性最多提升 29%。

arxiv.title: LastWords: Boring Problems Revisited
arxiv.abstract: In 2022, the second author published a Last Words piece in Computational Linguistics in which he pointed out that, despite the advances in AI up to that point, there were still some problems in natural language processing that on the one hand seemed trivial and perhaps boring, but on the other were hard to solve using purely neural methods. One such problem discussed in that context was text normalization, and a particular subproblem of that, namely number name reading. The piece came out just a few months before the first release of ChatGPT, and needless to say, a lot has happened since then. Indeed, as we document here, the problem (of number name reading) has practically been solved, at least by one of the latest frontier models. However, we believe that there are still open issues for such limited domain, constrained and limited resource problems, and that in some future machine learning approach, the massive resources of the latest frontier models would not be needed to solve them.

arxiv.title: Measuring Data Diversity with Embeddings: A Taxonomy and Benchmark for Diversity Measures
arxiv.abstract: Diversity is a critical property of text corpora, with direct implications for training data curation, test set design, and model generalization. However, its measurement remains fragmented and poorly understood. Existing embedding-based diversity measures vary widely in how they are computed and can yield substantially different diversity scores on the same data, yet no systematic comparison of their empirical behaviour exists. We make two contributions toward addressing this gap. First, we present a taxonomy of 21 embedding-based diversity measures, organizing them into four families based on their underlying computations. Second, we introduce EmbDivBench, a benchmark that evaluates these measures along three conceptually distinct components (variety, balance and disparity) on both simulated and natural text data. Although Mean Pairwise Distance is the most commonly used measure, our experiments show that it is outperformed by several alternatives on the three diversity components, with Graph Entropy being the best choice overall. Lastly, we distil these findings into practical recommendations for diversity measure selection.

arxiv.title: Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning with General Utilities via Neural Dual Critics
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning with general utilities optimizes nonlinear functionals of policy-induced occupancy measures. We develop a natural actor-critic method for concave RLGU objectives admitting an exact variational dual representation, with explicit constructions for a broad class of separable occupancy utilities. Rather than estimating the occupancy measure and then forming the policy-gradient pseudo-reward, our method learns this pseudo-reward directly as a function of the state-action pair using a neural critic. The critic is trained by projected stochastic updates, while multilevel Monte Carlo combines outputs across training horizons to control its bias at logarithmic expected cost. Our analysis separates conditional actor bias from estimator second moments and accounts explicitly for dual optimization, critic approximation, and neural linearization errors. Under policy-transfer, dual-stability, and local critic-regularity conditions, the method achieves $\widetilde{O}(T^{-1/2})$ global convergence above policy, critic-class, and finite-width approximation errors using $\widetilde{O}(T)$ expected environment transitions and reference samples. For a fixed critic representation, this yields $\widetilde{O}(ε^{-2})$ sampling complexity above the approximation floor, covering infinite state-action spaces and occupancy utilities beyond fixed finite vectors of returns.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于神经对偶 Critic 的一般效用样本高效强化学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向优化策略占用测度非线性泛函的一般效用强化学习，提出自然 actor-critic 方法:基于凹效用目标的精确变分对偶表示，不先估计占用测度再构造伪奖励，而用神经网络 critic 直接学习状态-动作对上的伪奖励，并以投影随机更新训练、多层蒙特卡洛在对数期望成本下控制偏差。理论上分离条件 actor 偏差与估计器二阶矩，显式计入对偶优化、critic 逼近与神经线性化误差，达到 Õ(T^{-1/2}) 全局收敛与 Õ(ε^{-2}) 采样复杂度，覆盖无限状态-动作空间。

arxiv.title: RAFT: Redundancy-Aware Input Filtering for Temporal Graph Neural Network Training
arxiv.abstract: Temporal graph neural networks (TGNNs) have shown strong performance on dynamic graph learning tasks by continuously updating node memories from evolving interactions (i.e., events) and leveraging these memories for downstream predictions. As graphs grow rapidly in modern applications, training requires processing an increasing number of events; meanwhile, each event can update node memories used by later events, creating dependencies that constrain parallel execution and limit the benefits of additional computing resources. These costs motivate an upstream question: Are all events, and the dependencies they introduce, necessary for learning? We investigate this question through two roles of temporal events: prediction targets and historical events sampled as inputs. We observe that targets involving stable node memories tend to exhibit lower prediction loss, while filtering historical events associated with stable memories can retain similar training-loss trajectories in several evaluated settings. Together, these observations suggest an opportunity to identify input redundancy through changes in node memories. Building on this opportunity, we propose RAFT, a redundancy-aware input-filtering framework for TGNN training. RAFT tracks memory changes during training and uses them to guide two filters: a root-event filter removes selected prediction targets before training, and a support-event filter excludes selected historical context during sampling. Filtering inputs before their downstream preparation and processing reduces the work they trigger. Across three TGNN models and five datasets, RAFT reduces training inputs by 35.23% on average and up to 97.11%, while reducing recorded training time by up to 52.56\% with negligible changes to model precisions.

arxiv.summaryZh: 时序图神经网络训练需要处理不断增长的事件流，且事件之间通过节点记忆更新形成依赖，限制了并行加速。该工作从预测目标与历史输入两种角色考察事件必要性，发现节点记忆稳定时对应的预测损失更低、相关历史事件过滤后训练损失轨迹基本不变，因而可用记忆变化量识别冗余。RAFT 据此设置根事件过滤器(训练前移除部分预测目标)与支撑事件过滤器(采样时跳过部分历史上下文)，在下游准备与处理之前完成过滤以减少实际计算。在三种 TGNN 模型、五个数据集上，训练输入平均减少 35.23%、最高 97.11%，记录训练时间最多下降 52.56%，精度变化可忽略。

arxiv.title: The One-Pixel of Reasoning: One Truthful Relation Is Enough to Mislead LLM Agents
arxiv.abstract: Can one sentence manipulate an agent's belief by targeting a single implicit warrant linking evidence to a conclusion? In this paper, we introduce the one-relation attack (ORA), a novel cognitive attack on this inferential relation. ORA localizes a critical implicit warrant and performs a one-relation intervention using a single source-grounded sentence that qualifies this warrant and steers the agent toward an incorrect belief. Across eighteen models on biomedical inference and vulnerability detection, best-of-$10 attacks overturn initially correct answers at mean rates of 54.9% for proprietary and 80.0% for open-weight models. Attacks also transfer without victim feedback, and paired controls support the roles of targeting and qualification. Moreover, successful sentences can pass source-support checks and evade identification, and multi-agent debate raises team error from 50.0% to 59.5% in our balanced stress test. These findings establish implicit warrants as a cognitive attack surface for manipulating agents' beliefs.

arxiv.titleZh: 推理的一像素：一个真实关系就足以误导 LLM 智能体
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对证据到结论之间的隐式担保（implicit warrant）这一推理环节，提出单关系攻击（ORA）：定位关键隐式担保，用一句有来源依据的话对该担保加以限定，把智能体导向错误信念。在生物医学推理与漏洞检测两项任务、18 个模型上，best-of-10 攻击使原本正确的答案平均翻转率达闭源模型 54.9%、开源模型 80.0%，且无需受害者反馈即可迁移。成功句子还能通过来源支持检查、规避识别，多智能体辩论在平衡压力测试中反而把团队错误率从 50.0% 抬到 59.5%，表明隐式担保是操纵智能体信念的认知攻击面。

arxiv.title: Bellman Language Models: Solving the Recurring Decisions of LLM Agents
arxiv.abstract: A general observation in agentic workflows, especially bounded ones, is that the decision space of the LLM, when we separate a decision from generation, starts approaching saturation: the agent meets the same states again and again, and after enough conversations it stops meeting new ones. LLMs generally don't treat these decisions as an optimization problem and instead re-derive them from their context/prompt on every turn. We show that treating decision making within reasonable bounds as an optimization problem, solving it once, and reusing the solved decisions can often make an agent faster, cheaper and more reliable. Our approach, which we call Discretize, Then Decide, starts from data such as the workflow's own logs or, when none exists, runs of the LLM agent itself. It reads each conversation into discrete states and estimates the probability of each outcome and the cost of each move, until no new states appear and the probabilities stop changing. It then solves the resulting Markov decision process. The solution runs as a controller around the model, sending moves whose content is fixed in the state, such as a tool call or a templated reply, and any state it hasn't seen is sent back to the LLM. We call an LLM run this way a Bellman language model (BLM), after Richard Bellman's equation for the best move in each state. On $τ^2$-bench telecom, the controller with no model solves 79% of tasks. As a BLM, Qwen3.8-27B, an open model, goes from 29% to 96% with 93% fewer model calls. For Claude Opus 5.5, which solves 96% of tasks on its own, running it as a BLM cuts model calls and cost per task by about 98% and lets it solve 2 more tasks. On InventoryBench, the solved policy with no model beats every published method. Where the hard part is writing content rather than choosing moves, such as resolving SymPy issues, few decisions can be solved in advance, and a BLM helps little.

arxiv.titleZh: 贝尔曼语言模型：解决 LLM Agent 中反复出现的决策

arxiv.title: FlowMaker: From Tasks to Cost-Efficient Generative AI Workflow Deployments
arxiv.abstract: Generative AI workflows execute user tasks by composing sequences of LLM calls, where each call performs a sub-task (e.g., summarization or translation), forming a workflow. Executing such workflows requires decisions over workflow structure, model assignments, and deployment configurations, which jointly determine latency, cost, and accuracy under dynamic workloads and resource constraints. Existing systems optimize these decisions in isolation or fix them early, leading to suboptimal cost and goodput. We make two key observations. First, efficient serving requires jointly exploring all combinations of workflows, model choices, and deployment configurations under dynamic cluster state. Second, reuse of deployed LLMs is critical for reducing cost, but must be performed on-the-fly, as reuse depends on current load and resource availability. Together, these make selecting a workflow-variant-a combination of workflow, models, and deployment configuration-a time-critical problem. We present FlowMaker, which exposes a task-level interface and selects workflow-variants on behalf of users. To realize this, we design a constraint-guided load-aware pruning algorithm for fast, on-the-fly decisions. FlowMaker improves goodput by up to 10.14$\times$ and reduces cost by up to 2.77$\times$ compared to state-of-the-art baselines, including Murakkab.
arxiv.titleZh: FlowMaker:从任务到成本高效的生成式 AI 工作流部署

arxiv.title: LLM-Based Evaluation Planning for Heterogeneous Optimization
arxiv.abstract: Heterogeneous optimization problems require an optimizer to decide not only which candidate solutions to evaluate, but also which objectives and constraints should be evaluated under different costs and fidelities. Existing SOTA methods such as MFE-NSGA-III address this setting with manually designed selection metrics, but their behavior is largely determined by predefined heuristic rules and hyperparameters. In this work, we propose REP-HO, a reasoning-based evaluation planner that replaces the rule-based mixed-fidelity selection step with a large language model (LLM) planner. The LLM receives the same primitive optimization-state information as the heuristic planner, such as surrogate predictions, uncertainties, evaluation costs, and budget status. We first show that REP-HO achieves competitive performance compared to the human-designed metric-based method (MFE-NSGA-III). We then further enhance each decision with an adaptive nearest-neighbor summary, leading to better and more stable results. We evaluate REP-HO across five heterogeneous regimes covering cost imbalance, constraint difficulty, surrogate fidelity, budget level, and objective conflict. Across these regimes, one of the two variants obtains the best mean ranking score in every regime, REP-HO(Deepseek) is first or second throughout, and the planner shows adaptive allocation behavior, such as prioritizing constraint evaluations under tighter budgets and reallocating constraint evaluation budget when surrogate reliability changes. These results suggest that LLMs can serve as flexible evaluation planners for heterogeneous optimization, offering a general alternative to fixed hand-designed metrics.

arxiv.titleZh: 面向异构优化的基于 LLM 的评估规划
arxiv.summaryZh: 异构优化要求优化器不仅决定评估哪些候选解，还要在不同成本与保真度下决定评估哪些目标与约束；现有 MFE-NSGA-III 依赖人工设计的混合保真度选择指标与超参数。REP-HO 将这一步换成 LLM 规划器，输入代理模型预测、不确定性、评估成本与预算状态等原始优化状态信息，并为每次决策附加自适应最近邻摘要以提升稳定性。在覆盖成本失衡、约束难度、代理保真度、预算水平与目标冲突的五种异构情境中，两个变体各自均取得最佳平均排名，REP-HO（DeepSeek）始终位列前二，并表现出随预算收紧优先评估约束、随代理可靠性变化重新分配约束评估预算的自适应行为。

arxiv.title: Learning to Program Retrievals: Composing Search Primitives via Reinforcement Learning
arxiv.abstract: Retrieval-augmented language models increasingly use multi-step search to solve knowledge-intensive tasks, yet existing systems typically expose retrieval through fixed pipelines or collections of atomic tools. We introduce Retrieval Program Learning (RPL), a programmable search framework that allows a policy to compose search primitives into executable programs with local state and control flow. This enables adaptive search that can retrieve broadly, process intermediate results, and selectively construct model context without tying retrieval breadth to context consumption. However, the resulting flexibility creates a difficult exploration problem: useful programs may require several coordinated decisions, while reinforcement learning often supplies only sparse feedback. To address this challenge, we propose program mutation, a grammar-constrained and execution-verified procedure that generates local variants of suboptimal programs sampled during RL, converts them into training trajectories, and distills them back into the policy. We evaluate RPL on open-domain question answering and corpus-level reasoning tasks, comparing it with a range of retrieval and reasoning baselines. RPL consistently improves open-domain QA performance across model sizes and in- and out-of-domain benchmarks, with particularly large gains on multi-hop tasks. Notably, a 4B model trained with RPL outperforms all 8B model baselines. On corpus-level reasoning, RPL achieves the highest answer F1 and document-coverage F1 for both model sizes while substantially reducing context consumption and retrieval turns. Our results show that programmable search expands the retrieval strategies that agents can learn, while program mutation provides an effective mechanism for exploring useful program structures beyond direct on-policy sampling.
arxiv.titleZh: 学习编程式检索：通过强化学习组合搜索原语
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有检索增强系统把检索写成固定流水线或原子工具集合，检索宽度与上下文消耗被绑死。RPL 让策略把搜索原语组合成带局部状态与控制流的可执行程序，实现先广泛检索、再处理中间结果、最后选择性构建模型上下文的灵活搜索；针对由此带来的稀疏反馈探索难题，提出程序变异：对 RL 采样到的次优程序做文法约束、执行验证的局部变体生成，转成训练轨迹再蒸馏回策略。在开放域问答上跨模型规模与域内外基准稳定提升，多跳任务增益尤大，4B 模型超过所有 8B 基线；语料级推理上答案 F1 与文档覆盖 F1 均最高，同时显著降低上下文消耗与检索轮次。

arxiv.title: MisleadQA: Diagnosing LLM Failures under Misleading Context
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used to answer questions from retrieved or user-provided context. However, provided context can be factually true yet out-of-scope, describing a different entity, time, or location from the one the question targets, and still lead models to a wrong answer. Prior work has mainly studied factually false or irrelevant context. It remains unclear whether such out-of-scope context misleads models as much as false context, and whether adding gold context prevents models from being misled by either. We introduce **MisleadQA**, a diagnostic dataset of multiple-choice questions with an abstention option. Each question pairs gold context (G) with true but out-of-scope context (S) and false but in-scope context (F) supporting the same wrong answer. We evaluate six open-weight LLMs. On questions they answer correctly without context, providing S alone leads them to switch to this wrong answer in 29.3% of cases, and providing F alone does so in 75.4%. Adding G nearly removes the effect of S, but F still misleads models in 21.0% of cases, especially when F comes first. A context-faithful instruction reduces these errors mainly through abstention and lowers accuracy even with G. These findings suggest that evaluations should check whether context applies to the question, not only whether it is true, and should report correct, misled, and abstention rates together. Data and code are available at [https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MisleadQA](https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MisleadQA).
arxiv.titleZh: MisleadQA：诊断模型在误导性上下文下的失败
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有工作多研究事实错误或无关的上下文，却少有关注「事实为真但不适用」的越界上下文（实体、时间、地点与问题不符）是否同样能误导模型。作者构建诊断数据集 MisleadQA：多选题附带弃答选项，每题同时配对金标准上下文（G）、真实但越界的上下文（S）与虚假但切题的上下文（F），且 S 与 F 指向同一错误答案。在六个开放权重 LLM 上评测发现：无上下文时能答对的题目，仅给 S 会让模型在 29.3% 的情况下改选错误答案，仅给 F 则为 75.4%；加入 G 几乎消除 S 的误导，但 F 仍有 21.0% 的概率致错，且 F 排在前面时更严重；要求忠于上下文的指令主要通过弃答降低错误率，但即便有 G 也拉低准确率。该结果表明评测需同时检查上下文是否适用于问题而非仅看其真假，并并列报告正确率、被误导率与弃答率。
arxiv.reason: 揭示越界上下文误导，属评测与方法学扎实工作

arxiv.title: An Impossibility Result for ETF Target Geometry, and an Equinorm Remedy for Imbalanced Analytic Continual Learning
arxiv.abstract: Analytic continual learning (ACL) methods such as ACIL and GACL fit a ridge-regression classifier head on frozen features via the Sherman-Morrison-Woodbury identity, achieving exemplar-free, exact updates. A separate line of work, Progressive Neural Collapse (ProNC), shows standard continual classifiers benefit from a progressively expanding Simplex Equiangular Tight Frame (ETF) target. It is natural to ask whether fusing the two ideas, exact analytic updates and ETF targets, would yield a better closed-form continual learner. We show this is not the case as the fusion turns out to be identical to plain one-hot ACIL. Further, Simplex ETFs are not nested across class counts, so the literal "progressively expand the ETF" construction stops yielding an ETF as new tasks arrive, and it introduces catastrophic forgetting ($4\times$ that of a classic ACIL head). We therefore separate an ETF's two defining properties, equiangularity and equinormality, and apply each on its own to the classifier weights rather than the targets, where the invariance above does not hold. Equinorm post-processing of the fitted weights recovers both tail-class and overall average accuracy across the long-tailed regime from 5:1 to 100:1 imbalance (e.g. +32.0 tail-accuracy points and +16.0 average-accuracy points at 100:1 on CIFAR-100/ViT), transferring in sign across two backbones and two datasets, at a mild cost of 5.4 average-accuracy points on CIFAR-100/ViT on near-balanced streams (below $\approx 3{:}1$). Equiangular geometry, by contrast, is exactly inert on the target side but actively harmful on the weight side, usually losing to plain one-hot. Hence, the generally useful part of Neural Collapse geometry in Analytic Continual Learning is equinorm post-processing of the weights, becoming more useful as class imbalance grows; and equiangularity is at best a no-op and induces catastrophic forgetting at worst.

arxiv.titleZh: ETF 目标几何的一个不可能性结果，以及面向不平衡解析持续学习的等范数补救方法
arxiv.summaryZh: 将解析持续学习（ACIL/GACL）与 ETF 目标融合的做法被证明与普通 one-hot ACIL 完全等价；由于 Simplex ETF 在不同类别数之间并不嵌套，直接按字面意义“渐进扩展 ETF”的构造会带来约 4 倍于经典 ACIL 分类头的灾难性遗忘。作者因此把 ETF 的两个定义性质（等角性与等范数性）拆分开来，改为在分类器权重而不是目标上分别施加这两种性质。对拟合后的权重做等范数后处理，在 5:1 到 100:1 的长尾区间内同时恢复了尾部类别准确率与整体平均准确率：在 CIFAR-100/ViT 上，100:1 时尾部准确率提升 32.0 点、平均准确率提升 16.0 点；代价是在接近平衡（约 3:1 以内）的流上平均准确率下降 5.4 点。结论是，神经坍缩几何在解析持续学习中真正通用的部分是对权重的等范数后处理，且类别越不平衡收益越大；等角性在目标侧完全无效，在权重侧则有害。

arxiv.title: A Statistical Viewpoint on Adam, Shampoo and Muon
arxiv.abstract: We provide new statistical insights into designing stochastic optimization methods. By modeling the gradient via a normal distribution, we argue that the stochastic gradient should be whitened using its covariance. We give an online method for estimating the mean and variance of the gradients based on regularized likelihood or, equivalently, through a maximum a posteriori estimate. We then show how to use structured approximations to the covariance within this same framework, which includes diagonal and Kronecker-factored approximations. The diagonal approximation results in a method that is very closely related to Adam and performs as well in practice. The Kronecker approximation results in the new MN method, which is a variant of Shampoo and KL-Shampoo. We also recover Muon by applying this same statistical framework to the gradient direction rather than the full gradient. By combining this with a whitening step, we arrive at MN-Muon, a novel preconditioned version of Muon. Our experiments on GPT-2-type models at Chinchilla scale indicate that MND, the diagonal implementation of MN, outperforms both the Distributed Shampoo and the KL-Shampoo implementations in terms of stability, final validation loss and time taken. MND-Muon, the diagonal implementation of MN-Muon, improves on Muon in 21 of 24 paired GPT-small runs and achieves a lower best validation loss on GPT-medium, where it remains stable over the six tested learning rates. However, we found that NorMuon was comparable to MND-Muon and achieved a slightly lower validation loss on GPT-medium and at GPT-small batch 512 on FineWeb.
arxiv.titleZh: Adam、Shampoo与Muon的统计视角

arxiv.title: Pattern-Driven Evaluation of LLM Code Optimization: Isolating Compiler-Transcendent Semantic Reasoning
arxiv.abstract: Existing evaluations of LLM-based code optimization primarily measure end-to-end speedup, obscuring whether a model actually performs the intended optimization. For compiled languages, this is especially problematic: observed gains may reflect transformations already recoverable by modern optimizing compilers rather than optimization behavior attributable to the model itself. We present PatternBench, a benchmark for studying compiler-transcendent optimization, i.e., performance improvements that remain after aggressive compiler optimization. PatternBench targets residual optimization opportunities across seven classes of transformations and pairs runtime evaluation with an AST-based optimization faithfulness analysis that verifies whether the intended optimization is realized in the generated program. Experiments with frontier, open-weight, and fine-tuned models show that runtime speedup alone provides an incomplete account of optimization capability. Optimization faithfulness is strongly associated with realized speedup, and fine-tuning improves both faithfulness and optimization effectiveness. These results suggest that evaluation of LLM-based code optimization should measure not only performance outcomes, but also whether the target transformation was successfully executed.

arxiv.titleZh: 模式驱动的 LLM 代码优化评测：隔离编译器超越的语义推理
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对现有 LLM 代码优化评测只测端到端加速、无法判断模型是否真正完成目标变换的问题，提出 PatternBench：覆盖七类变换，只考察激进编译器优化后仍残留的优化空间（即“编译器超越”优化），并把运行时评测与基于 AST 的优化忠实度分析配对，检验生成程序是否实现了预期变换。在闭源前沿模型、开源权重模型与微调模型上的实验显示，仅看运行时加速会给出不完整的优化能力画像；优化忠实度与实际加速强相关，微调同时提升忠实度与优化有效性。该评测口径适用于编译型语言下代码模型与编程智能体的能力测量。

arxiv.title: Recurrent Temporal Restricted Boltzmann Machines as Unsupervised Encoders for Biomechanical Movement Sequences
arxiv.abstract: Biomechanical movement recordings are continuous, high-dimensional time series, and analyzing them without manually labeling them requires representations that capture how movements evolve over time. Most unsupervised representation-learning pipelines, however, treat each observation frame independently and discard this temporal structure, while energy-based models that could capture it have not extensively been adapted to biomechanical signals. So, this paper implements the Recurrent Temporal Restricted Boltzmann Machine (RTRBM), a recurrent energy-based model, into an unsupervised encoder that maps windows of movement data to fixed-length embeddings, and tests what its recurrent structure contributes. We adapt the model to continuous-valued signals, stack it into a deep architecture, and integrate it into the SIT-FUSE segmentation pipeline. We evaluate the embeddings on simulated musculoskeletal reaching and on two real gait datasets, using clustering, reconstruction, and walking-speed classification of unseen subjects, and compare them against non-recurrent and non-probabilistic baselines, including a control that removes the recurrent connection. Clustering the embeddings recovers movement structure tied to progress toward the target without any labels, which also transfers to unseen episodes. On gait data, the embeddings outperform PCA and autoencoder baselines under a nonlinear probe. However, removing the recurrent connection does not yield a measurable loss on the reaching task, and simple per-channel summary statistics classify walking speed at least as well as the embeddings. The model is therefore a working, verified encoder for SIT-FUSE, while the evidence for a benefit of recurrence is mixed, and the learned embeddings did not outperform simple summary statistics on gait.

arxiv.titleZh: 循环时序受限玻尔兹曼机作为生物力学运动序列的无监督编码器
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对生物力学运动记录这类连续高维时间序列，将循环时序受限玻尔兹曼机适配到连续值信号并堆叠为深度无监督编码器，把滑动窗口映射为定长嵌入，再接入SIT-FUSE分割流程。在模拟肌肉骨骼伸手任务和两个真实步态数据集上，用聚类、重建与未见受试者步速分类评估：嵌入可无标签恢复与目标进度相关的运动结构并迁移到新片段，在非线性探针下优于PCA与自编码器基线。但去除循环连接在伸手任务上未带来可测损失，逐通道汇总统计量分类步速至少不差，循环结构的收益证据不一致。

arxiv.title: Compose the Horizon: Parameter-Shared Blockwise Forecasting under a Sequential-Compute Trade-off
arxiv.abstract: Most long-horizon forecasters emit the complete future in one pass. We ask whether a compact operator can instead be reused to emit contiguous future blocks, trading stored parameters for sequential computation. Recursive Functional Decomposition (RFD) factorizes the horizon mapping into three parameter-shared block predictions. The blocks occupy disjoint future intervals and are concatenated, not added as trend, seasonal, or residual components, and each emitted block joins the rolling context that conditions the next application. In controlled three-seed experiments, removing forward feedback hurts all four evaluated datasets while stopping gradients through it changes little, so the useful signal is the evolving forecast state itself; reapplying the shared operator helps consistently, but by less than widening it. The model uses 0.08--0.46M parameters, yet its sequential channel-wise execution is slower and more memory-intensive than an iterative baseline at high channel count. In a frozen long-context evaluation against ten strong baseline families, RFD records lower test error in 23 of 24 cells; the comparison is cross-protocol, with RFD using 512/720-step context and the baselines using 96.
arxiv.titleZh: 编排地平线：顺序计算权衡下的参数共享分块预测
arxiv.summaryZh: 长程预测通常一次输出整段未来；能否复用一个紧凑算子逐块生成相邻未来，以参数换顺序计算？递归函数分解（RFD）把整个horizon映射拆成三个参数共享的分块预测，各块占据不相交未来区间并拼接（非趋势/季节/残差相加），每块并入滚动上下文以条件化下一次调用。四个数据集、三个随机种子的实验显示：去掉前向反馈后全部变差，而截断其梯度影响很小，说明有效信号来自不断演化的预测状态本身；重复调用共享算子稳定有益，但不及加宽模型。模型仅0.08–0.46M参数，在高通道数下，顺序执行反而比迭代基线更慢、更占内存；冻结长上下文评测中，相对十个强基线族在24个格子中23个误差更低，但属跨协议比较（RFD用512/720步上下文，基线仅96步）。
arxiv.reason: 时序预测与参数共享架构，与LLM后训练/Agent方向无交集

arxiv.title: Teaching Code Agents to Ask Without Leaking Private Code
arxiv.abstract: Local coding agents can extend their reach by consulting a stronger cloud model. Such consultations, however, often expose the repository's private identifiers, file paths, and source code. Host-side masking hides recognized identifiers but leaves the surrounding code and the agent's phrasing unchanged, while training for less disclosure risks suppressing consultation or producing questions too vague to answer. We propose utility-verified abstraction (UVA), which teaches the agent to describe private entities by their role and type while retaining the technical details an expert needs. From solved repair trajectories, we rewrite each question into this form and keep the rewrite only if it discloses fewer private entities and the repair, replayed from the same execution state with the repair trajectories. Across two benchmarks, the trained agent consults more often than before training. On repository-level issue repair, it solves 37.6% of issues, against 25.3% for the same model working alone, a gain from the training as a whole rather than from consultation alone. Its questions disclose 3.7-fold fewer private entities and 1.4-fold less verbatim code than the untrained agent's questions to the same expert.
arxiv.comment: 10 pages of main text, 33 pages in total with references and appendix, 4 figures, 5 tables
arxiv.titleZh: 教代码智能体在不泄露私有代码的前提下提问
arxiv.summaryZh: 本地代码智能体向更强的云端模型求助时，会把仓库中的私有标识符、文件路径与源码一并暴露出去。UVA 从已解决的修复轨迹出发，把每个问题改写为按角色与类型描述私有实体的抽象形式，只有当改写后泄露的私有实体更少、且从同一执行状态重放仍能完成修复时才保留该样本用于训练。在两个基准上，训练后的智能体更频繁地发起咨询，在仓库级 issue 修复上解决 37.6% 的问题，而同模型独立工作为 25.3%;其提问泄露的私有实体减少 3.7 倍，逐字代码减少 1.4 倍。该工作为代码智能体的隐私安全协作与咨询式 scaffold 训练提供了可验证的抽象化方案。

arxiv.title: Pair-Aware Optimization: Coordinating Exploration and Refinement for Jailbreaking LLM Agents
arxiv.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are vulnerable to adversarial inputs that induce attacker-specified malicious behaviors, commonly referred to as jailbreaking. Existing optimization-based jailbreak attacks primarily employ first-order (FO) methods that leverage gradient information or zeroth-order (ZO) methods that rely on function-value feedback. However, their complementarity and optimization ordering remain underexplored. We systematically investigate four strategies: pure ZO, pure FO, ZO->FO, and FO->ZO, and develop a ZO-FO framework that explores adversarial prefixes through ZO optimization and refines their corresponding suffixes through FO optimization. To coordinate the two processes, we introduce Pair-aware optimization, which retains multiple prefix candidates, conditionally refines their suffixes and selects among the resulting prefix-suffix pairs. We further investigate agent jailbreaking from a more general stochastic-generation perspective, where the same adversarial input can induce diverse reasoning trajectories and actions that a single greedy output cannot capture. Accordingly, we adopt consistent stochastic decoding during both optimization and evaluation. Experiments across malicious-instruction and malicious-environment benchmarks demonstrate that hybrid optimization improves attack effectiveness over single-optimizer methods, while optimization order substantially influences performance.
arxiv.titleZh: 配对感知优化：协同探索与精炼以越狱 LLM Agent
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有基于优化的越狱攻击分为利用梯度的一阶方法与依赖函数值反馈的零阶方法，两者的互补性与优化顺序缺乏系统研究。工作比较纯 ZO、纯 FO、ZO→FO、FO→ZO 四种策略，提出 ZO-FO 框架：用 ZO 探索对抗前缀，再用 FO 精炼对应后缀，并以配对感知优化保留多个前缀候选、按条件精炼后缀、在候选前缀-后缀对之间择优。同时从随机生成视角出发，在优化与评估中统一采用一致的随机解码，以覆盖同一对抗输入引发的多样推理轨迹与动作。在恶意指令与恶意环境两个基准上，混合优化优于单一优化器，且优化顺序显著影响攻击效果。
arxiv.reason: LLM Agent 越狱攻击，混合 ZO/FO 机制清晰，属安全侧扎实工作

arxiv.title: Efficiency Measured in English: Tokeniser Coverage Bounds Small Language Models on Indic Scripts
arxiv.abstract: Small Language Models with quantisation and parameter-efficient adaptation are widely offered as the route to multilingual AI under compute constraints, and their efficiency is almost always reported as a single memory figure. We show that this figure is measured in English and does not transfer. Across a 131k-sentence corpus spanning eleven Indic scripts, TinyLlama-1.1B's tokeniser emits 1.34 subword tokens per Latin-script word and 22.60 per Kannada word. This is not inefficiency; it is absence. Its vocabulary contains 0% of Odia's codepoints, 1% of Telugu's and 2% of Kannada's, and for five of eleven scripts the measured fertility sits at the UTF-8 byte-fallback ceiling, on Odia at 99.6% of it, with 93.6% of emitted tokens being raw bytes. Because SentencePiece byte fallback never raises an unknown-token marker, this failure is entirely silent: TinyLlama's UNK rate is 0.0% on every script, including the one it reads as bytes. We further show that low fertility can indicate the opposite of efficiency: mBERT posts its best score anywhere (1.10 tokens/word, on Odia) while discarding 87.9% of the text as UNK. MuRIL, an Indic-vocabulary encoder with a fifth of TinyLlama's parameters, reads every script at 1.23-2.26 tokens/word with zero UNK and zero byte fallback. The binding constraint is the vocabulary, not the parameter count. The consequence is concrete: on a 2048-token context window, the same model gives an English user 1,528 words of usable context and a Kannada user 91.
arxiv.titleZh: 用英语衡量的效率：分词器覆盖率决定了小语言模型在印度文字上的表现
arxiv.summaryZh: 小语言模型常被视为低算力下的多语言方案，但其效率却只用单一显存数字衡量。覆盖十一种印度文字的13.1万句语料显示，TinyLlama-1.1B对拉丁文字每词输出1.34个subword，对卡纳达语则达22.60个；其词表覆盖0%的奥迪亚文字码位、1%的泰卢固语、2%的卡纳达语，十一种文字中有五种的分词生育率逼近UTF-8字节回退上限（奥迪亚语达99.6%），93.6%的输出是原始字节，而字节回退不会触发UNK标记，失效完全静默。mBERT以1.10 token/词的最优生育率把87.9%文本判为UNK，参数仅五分之一的MuRIL则以1.23–2.26 token/词做到零UNK、零字节回退：瓶颈在词表而非参数量，2048上下文下英语用户可用1528词，卡纳达语用户仅91词。
arxiv.reason: 分词器多语言覆盖的扎实分析，但离后训练/Agent主线较远

arxiv.title: First-Order LoRA Training with Phone NPUs
arxiv.abstract: On-device fine-tuning lets a large language model (LLM) learn from its user's private data without uploading it. Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) reduces the trainable parameters, but each first-order training step still multiplies by the frozen base-model weights during the forward pass, activation recomputation, and input-gradient computation. A phone's neural processing unit (NPU) already holds these weights for inference; using it for training also requires computing input gradients, which its inference interface does not support. We present a system that runs all three frozen-weight products on the NPU while keeping the training graph, adapters, and optimizer on the CPU. Its input-gradient kernels reuse the resident weight tiles and the forward dequantizer, avoiding a transposed weight copy and ensuring forward and backward use the same effective weights. To preserve usable gradients, the system selects precision by gradient sensitivity and applies a per-row range guard for half-precision (FP16) outputs. Its runtime fuses the remaining CPU operators and overlaps NPU execution with adapter computation, while resumable execution and thermal pacing let training proceed as a background job. We evaluate it on two Qualcomm Snapdragon platforms using four LLMs from the Qwen and Llama families. Our workloads cover nightly personalization with labels supplied on the phone and the public LaMP-2 benchmark; comparisons include an optimized CPU trainer, a phone-GPU trainer, forward-only training, and GPU-trained references.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于手机NPU的一阶LoRA训练
arxiv.summaryZh: 端侧LoRA微调每一步仍要在前向、激活重算与输入梯度计算中与冻结的基座权重相乘，而手机NPU只提供推理接口，不支持输入梯度。该系统把这三处冻结权重乘积全部交给NPU，训练图、适配器与优化器留在CPU；输入梯度kernel复用常驻权重tile与前向量化器，免去转置权重拷贝，并按梯度敏感度选择精度、对FP16输出做逐行range guard；运行时融合剩余CPU算子、重叠NPU与适配器计算，配合可恢复执行与热控节奏支持后台训练。在两种骁龙平台、Qwen与Llama四个模型上，覆盖夜间个性化与LaMP-2基准，并与优化CPU训练器、手机GPU训练器、仅前向训练及GPU训练参考对比。
arxiv.reason: 端侧LoRA训练系统，NPU复用冻结权重，属高效训练方向

arxiv.title: Ask, Don't Guess: Targeted Clarification for Speech Recognition Errors
arxiv.abstract: Speech recognition in real time in far-field conversational settings still incurs significant errors. Identifying potential error spans during streaming ASR permits a recourse mechanism where the speaker can be asked to repeat the affected content under cleaner acoustic conditions. We propose \sysname, a new framework for online error localization, that identifies spans likely to benefit from this intervention. Our supervision uses clean audio to estimate how the recognizer's output might change under improved acoustic conditions. We probabilistically align noisy and clean decodes using a pair-HMM to obtain soft supervision. These soft targets train a counterfactual gain scorer by combining a suite of acoustic and language features to produce token-level scores, that are further grouped into spans for targeted recourse. An LLM uses the ASR transcript of the repetition to revise only the selected span. At a precision of $70\%$, \sysname achieves the highest recall by identifying up to 52\% more erroneous tokens compared to the strongest baseline. Targeted repetition yields relative WER reductions of up to 24\% under a budget that accounts for both interruption frequency and the lengths of re-uttered spans.
arxiv.comment: Submitted to NAACL 2027
arxiv.titleZh: 问，而不要猜：面向语音识别错误的定向澄清
arxiv.summaryZh: 远场对话场景中的流式ASR仍会产生显著错误；与其事后猜测并纠正，不如让说话人在更干净的声学条件下重说可疑片段。为此，方法用干净音频估计识别器输出在声学条件改善后会如何变化，并用pair-HMM对含噪解码与干净解码做概率对齐，得到软监督；再用这些软目标训练一个反事实增益打分器，该打分器融合声学与语言特征，输出token级分数并聚合成片段；最后，由LLM根据重说片段的ASR转写，只改写被选中的片段。在70%精确率下，该方法相比最强基线多召回最多52%的错误token；在同时计入打断频率与重说长度的预算下，定向重说带来最高24%的相对WER下降。

arxiv.title: Medical Fine-Tuning Reshapes, Not Reduces, Patient-Facing AI Risk: A Rubric-Based, LLM-Judge Evaluation Framework
arxiv.abstract: Patient-facing medical question answering with large language models (LLMs) is moving from research demonstrations to production deployments, yet evaluation remains anchored on factual correctness. Factuality is necessary but not sufficient: a response can be factually grounded and still issue a directive that, if acted on, would harm the patient. We introduce a risk-sensitive evaluation framework that scores responses by the presence and severity of six categories of risk-bearing language (treatment directives, contraindications, dosage expressions, urgency-triage cues, high-alert medication mentions, and overconfident assertions), anchored on published clinical harm taxonomies. Severity is classified by a three-judge LLM ensemble. We apply this framework to six 7-9B instruction-tuned models, three general (Mistral-7B, Phi-3.5-mini, Llama-3.1-8B) and three medically adapted (BioMistral-7B, OpenBioLLM-Llama3-8B, Med42-Llama3-8B), on 200 real patient questions from the K-QA benchmark. Two findings emerge. First, ensemble risk-bearing language is statistically independent of factual hallucination rate (pooled Spearman $ρ= -0.065$, $n = 300$, 95% CI $[-0.18, +0.05]$; distance correlation $= 0.10$, independence test $p = 0.24$). Second, medical fine-tuning does not reduce aggregate risk but reshapes it: continued-pretraining adaptations (BioMistral, OpenBioLLM) consistently suppress high-alert medication mentions while amplifying overconfident assertions, whereas clinical instruction-tuning (Med42) suppresses dosing only, without amplifying overconfidence. Per-category Krippendorff $α$ is fair to good for the four linguistically anchored categories (0.53-0.71) and low for the two clinical-judgment-dependent categories (0.19, 0.31), indicating where automatic safety evaluation is and is not yet reliable. We release the rubric, judge prompts, and evaluation code.
arxiv.titleZh: 医疗微调重塑而非降低面向患者的AI风险：一套基于评分量表的LLM评委评估框架
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向患者的医疗问答评测仍以事实正确性为锚，但事实无误的回答同样可能给出有害指令。工作提出风险敏感框架：按六类风险语言（治疗指令、剂量、禁忌、分诊提示、高警示药物、过度自信）打分，三评委LLM集成判定严重度，在K-QA的200个真实患者问题上评测六个7–9B模型。结果显示风险语言与幻觉率统计独立（Spearman ρ=-0.065）；医疗微调不降低总风险而是重塑结构——继续预训练压制高警示药物提及却放大过度自信，临床指令微调仅抑制剂量表述。四类语言锚定类别的Krippendorff α为0.53–0.71，两类依赖临床判断的仅0.19与0.31。

arxiv.title: Table Serialization Determines Which Relations Language Models Preserve
arxiv.abstract: We study how text serialization affects table lookup in instruction-tuned language models. Our diagnostic asks the model to find the row containing a specified value under one named column, then return the value under another named column in that same row. We render the same synthetic 256-cell tables in row-major form and in column-major form with each header placed beside its values, while varying the table aspect ratio across five shapes. Across three models, the better format changes with table shape: row-major performs better on tall tables, whereas column-major performs better on wide tables. At 64 x 4, row-major leads by 42.3-54.0 percentage points; at 4 x 64, column-major leads by 35.0-59.0 points. Mapping wrong answers back to their source cells reveals a complementary error pattern: row-major tends to preserve the correct row but lose the target column, while column-major tends to preserve the correct column but lose the row. We use the term relational locality to describe this pattern: serialization keeps one relation locally available while making the other depend on positional alignment. A separate non-tabular ordering experiment supports this interpretation. Thus, apparent width-related failures in text-serialized tables depend on linearization, not table shape alone.
arxiv.titleZh: 表格序列化方式决定了语言模型能够保留哪些关系
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究表格文本序列化如何影响指令微调模型的查表能力：让模型在指定列中找到含某值的行，再返回同一行另一指定列的值；把同一批256格合成表分别按行优先与列优先渲染（表头紧随其值），并改变五种长宽比。在三个模型上，更优格式随表格形状反转：64×4时行优先领先42.3–54.0个百分点，4×64时列优先领先35.0–59.0个百分点。将错答回溯到源单元格显示出互补错误模式：行优先常保住正确的行却丢失目标列，列优先则相反；这一现象被称为“关系局部性”。另有一项非表格排序实验支持该解释，说明表格宽度相关的失败取决于线性化方式，并不只取决于形状本身。
arxiv.reason: 表格序列化对查表的影响，属评测方法学，分量有限

arxiv.title: Who Gets Unmasked? Sampler-Induced Bias in Diffusion Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate by gradually unmasking a canvas, so their samplers decide not only which token to write but also when to commit it. We show that this second decision changes who appears in generated text, a sampler-induced bias on top of the model's own. Common commit rules, including LLaDA's default, commit the positions whose sampled tokens are most probable; this peeking favors majority options. To separate the sampler from the model, we read the model's belief about a fork, such as a protagonist's gender, in one forward pass, and show that this belief matches exact sampling from the model. Measured against it, peeking samplers on LLaDA and Dream amplify occupational gender stereotypes and collapse opinion distributions, and confidence-based ordering shifts gender-balanced occupations toward men, more so under faster parallel decoding. We propose Fork-First Sampling, which decides the fork before anything else is written: it follows the belief or any target distribution, improves fluency, and avoids the stories that remark on the protagonist's gender, which prompt-based fixes produce, at the cost of one forward pass. Fairness evaluations of dLLMs should report the commit rule.
arxiv.titleZh: 谁被解掩码？扩散语言模型中的采样器诱导偏差
arxiv.summaryZh: 扩散语言模型逐位解掩码生成，采样器不仅决定写入哪个 token，还决定何时提交。常见的“提交最可能位置”规则（包括 LLaDA 默认规则）会提前查看已采样 token，从而偏向多数选项。作者用一次前向传播读出模型对分叉（如主角性别）的信念，并证明该信念与从模型精确采样一致；据此发现，LLaDA 与 Dream 上提前查看已采样 token 的采样器会放大职业性别刻板印象、压扁观点分布，基于置信度的排序把性别均衡的职业推向男性，且并行解码越快偏移越大。为此提出的 Fork-First Sampling 先确定分叉再写内容，可跟随模型信念或任意目标分布，提升流畅度，并避免基于提示的修补所导致的“点明性别”叙述，代价仅为一次前向；评估 dLLM 公平性时应报告提交规则。
arxiv.reason: 扩散语言模型采样偏见，落在画像明确排除的扩散方向

arxiv.title: When LLM-Generated Refactorings Ripple: An Empirical Study of Repository Adoption Readiness
arxiv.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to refactor source files, but file-local evaluations do not reveal changes to contracts, dependencies, or caller assumptions affecting repository adoption. To address this gap, we conduct 1,500 generation attempts across 150 production files from 15 open-source Java repositories, five LLM configurations, and two dependency-aware generation conditions: single-prompt refactoring and LangGraph-based multi-agent refactoring. Of these attempts, 1,455 yield complete candidates eligible for analysis. We evaluate these candidates using local changes, repository-facing structural indicators, detected caller impact, the behavioural-equivalence indicator, and available test evidence, and categorize them as Low-risk, Review-needed, High Contract/Dependency Risk, or Inconclusive. The results show that 1,365 candidates (93.8%) are classified as High Contract/Dependency Risk, whereas 106 (7.3%) have at least one detected broken downstream caller and 290 (19.9%) have a false behavioural-equivalence indicator; only eight satisfy the Low-risk criteria. Within the reason-covered subset, the High-risk rate decreases under more conservative dependency-delta thresholds, while 60 of the 65 candidates with conclusive targeted-test outcomes pass, including 50 classified as High risk. Paired analyses of 705 complete pairs identify no statistically significant generation-condition difference in the principal risk indicators, although model configurations differ in specific detected risk channels. These findings suggest that practitioners should treat LLM-generated refactorings as candidates requiring staged repository-level verification, while future research should validate screening and extraction precision and strengthen compilation, behavioural, and coordinated multi-file verification.
arxiv.titleZh: 当LLM生成的重构引发连锁影响：一项关于仓库采纳就绪度的实证研究
arxiv.summaryZh: 文件局部评估无法揭示LLM重构对契约、依赖与调用方假设的影响，仓库级采纳风险因此被低估。研究在15个开源Java仓库的150个生产文件上开展1500次生成尝试，覆盖5种模型配置与单提示、LangGraph多智能体两种依赖感知条件，并结合局部改动、仓库结构指标、调用方影响与测试证据对候选进行分类。1455个候选中，1365个（93.8%）被判为高契约/依赖风险，106个（7.3%）破坏下游调用方，290个（19.9%）行为等价指示为假，仅8个低风险；705对配对分析未发现两种生成条件的显著差异，LLM重构宜视为需分阶段仓库级验证的候选。
arxiv.reason: 代码智能中的仓库级重构实证，数据扎实但偏评估

arxiv.title: IndustrialCAD-1400: Benchmarking Detailed Industrial Assemblies from Text
arxiv.abstract: Industrial assemblies require more than a recognizable shape: functional parts, interfaces, dimensions and service features must satisfy a detailed request together. We introduce IndustrialCAD-1400, a text-to-CAD benchmark for this industrial setting. Its 1,400 requests combine 400 equipment categories across 40 domains with 250 four-case design families. Family requests specify a median of 17 named component or configuration roles and six explicit numeric targets; controlled variants test whether dimensions change while shared structure is retained. Task construction draws on documented manufacturer information, owner specifications and engineering guidance. Models generate geometry programs from requests, and a common Blender environment executes them to produce scenes, optional measurements, and standardized views for evaluation. A request assessment of front, isometric, and top views measures visible component, arrangement, and interface fulfillment without requiring a single reference geometry. Five stratified panels preserve complete families while covering the benchmark exactly once, enabling balanced comparisons and separating industrial breadth from controlled numerical responsiveness. In conclusion, IndustrialCAD-1400 extends text-to-CAD from recognizable part geometry to industrial assembly synthesis under joint component, interface, spatial, and numerical specifications.
arxiv.titleZh: IndustrialCAD-1400:从文本生成工业装配体的基准评测
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对工业装配体需同时满足功能零件、接口、尺寸与维护特征的难点，构建文本到CAD的基准。包含40个领域、400类设备的1400条请求，并组织为250个四例设计族，每族中位数指定17个命名部件或配置角色与6个显式数值目标，通过受控变体检验结构不变时尺寸是否随文本改变。模型由请求生成几何程序，统一在Blender中执行并渲染前视、等距、俯视三视图，据可见部件、布局与接口完成度评分，无需单一参考几何;五个分层子集完整保留设计族且恰好覆盖基准一次。该工作把文本到CAD从可识别零件几何推进到部件的组件、接口、空间与数值联合约束下的装配体合成评测。
arxiv.reason: 文本到CAD的3D装配基准，属几何生成方向，与LLM后训练仅弱相关

arxiv.title: Process-Aware Event Log Augmentation for Process Prediction under Labeled Data Scarcity
arxiv.abstract: Predictive Process Monitoring (PPM) forecasts future events of ongoing business processes based on event logs. However, deep learning PPM approaches are often limited by labeled data scarcity and the low variability of real-world logs. To address this, we introduce SiamSA-PPM, a self-supervised framework combining Siamese learning with statistically grounded data augmentation. It employs novel transformation methods that leverage control-flow semantics and frequent behavioral patterns to generate realistic, semantically valid trace variants, learning generalizable prefix representations without labeled supervision. Extensive experiments on real-world event logs with a wide range of variability, incorporating exhaustive hyperparameter tuning, demonstrate the value of this process-aware augmentation. Compared to state-of-the-art baselines, SiamSA-PPM achieves competitive or superior predictive performance in both next activity and final outcome prediction tasks. An open source implementation of our method is publicly available under https://github.com/SvStraten/SiamSA-PPM-Extension..
arxiv.comment: This paper has been accepted for the International Journal of Cooperative Information Systems
arxiv.titleZh: 标签数据稀缺下面向过程预测的过程感知事件日志增强
arxiv.summaryZh: 预测性过程监控需要对进行中的业务流程预测后续事件，但深度模型受限于标注数据稀缺与真实日志变异性不足。SiamSA-PPM 将孪生网络自监督学习与基于统计的数据增强结合，利用控制流语义与高频行为模式生成语义合法、贴近真实的轨迹变体，从而在无标签监督下学习可泛化的前缀表示。在多种变异性水平的真实事件日志上经充分超参搜索验证，该方法在下一活动预测与最终结果预测任务上达到与当前最优基线相当或更优的性能，并已开源实现。工作面向业务流程管理场景，为小样本事件序列建模提供了可复用的增强思路。
arxiv.reason: 过程挖掘垂直应用，不涉及 LLM 与后训练方向

arxiv.title: Global Convergence in Deep Networks via the Second Law of Thermodynamics
arxiv.abstract: Existing convergence analyses of finite-width overparameterized deep neural networks under standard parameterization often rely on parameters remaining close to their initialization and typically neglect the role of noise, despite empirical evidence that stochasticity can improve optimization and generalization. To bridge this gap, we study $L_2$-regularized continuous-time Langevin dynamics (CLD) with isotropic noise, for training feedforward networks with smooth activations. We introduce a change-of-measure inequality, inspired by the second law of thermodynamics, that enables control of key properties of the training dynamics under the time-evolving parameter distribution. Leveraging a sharpened lower bound on the minimum eigenvalue of the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) at initialization, we show that injected noise helps preserve NTK stability with high probability without confining the weights to a small neighborhood of their initialization. As a result, we derive a non-asymptotic upper bound on the expected training loss. Our analysis yields explicit conditions on width and noise temperature that guarantee convergence to a finite loss floor. Finally, we experimentally show the network Jacobian can change from initialization, departing the commonly analyzed lazy regime.
arxiv.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026
arxiv.titleZh: 深度网络通过热力学第二定律的全局收敛性
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对标准参数化下有限宽度过参数化网络的收敛分析通常依赖参数停留在初始化附近、并忽略噪声作用的问题，研究带各向同性噪声的L2正则连续时间Langevin动力学训练光滑激活前馈网络的收敛性。引入受热力学第二定律启发的测度变换不等式，在参数分布随时间演化的情况下控制训练动力学性质；结合初始化处NTK最小特征值的更紧下界，证明注入噪声可在高概率下保持NTK稳定而不把权重限制在初始化小邻域内。由此给出期望训练损失的非渐近上界，并给出保证收敛到有限损失下限的宽度与噪声温度显式条件；实验显示网络Jacobian可偏离初始化，脱离常见的lazy regime。
arxiv.reason: 纯优化理论分析，NTK+Langevin，与LLM方向仅训练稳定性擦边

arxiv.title: DialogMem: Evaluating Dialogue-Grounded Embodied Memory in 3D Environments
arxiv.abstract: Embodied agents in human-centered environments require memory that integrates what they observe with what humans tell them over time. However, existing embodied memories are built primarily from visual experience, leaving open how dialogue with humans can be grounded in the objects encountered throughout that experience. We introduce DialogMem, a two-phase benchmark in which agents build memory from time-aligned streams of posed RGB-D observations and dialogue, and later use it for instance-level object navigation and question answering (QA). DialogMem provides 142 episodes across 27 real-world 3D scenes, with 14,193 QA pairs and 11,890 navigation instructions. We evaluate nine memory representations within a unified framework of memory formation, evidence retrieval, and reasoning for task outputs. In experiments, appending dialogue to visual memory at evaluation time substantially improves QA but yields negligible navigation gains, suggesting that relevant dialogue is present in memory but not grounded to specific objects. Controlled diagnostics show that navigation improves with link quality but falls short of ground-truth object-level memory even under perfect linking. Retrieving the correct object entry and recovering its spatial location remain further bottlenecks. These results identify three bottlenecks for dialogue-grounded embodied memory: grounding and organizing dialogue at object-level entries during formation, retrieving the correct entry, and localizing it accurately.
arxiv.titleZh: DialogMem：评估3D环境中基于对话的具身记忆
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有具身记忆多由视觉经验构建，难以把人类对话与沿途遇到的物体对应起来。为此提出两阶段基准 DialogMem：智能体先由时间对齐的带位姿RGB-D观测流与对话流建立记忆，再用于实例级物体导航与问答。基准覆盖27个真实3D场景、142个episode、14193条QA与11890条导航指令，并在统一的记忆形成—证据检索—推理框架下评测九种记忆表示；实验显示评估时把对话追加到视觉记忆可显著提升QA，却几乎不改善导航，说明对话虽在记忆中但未绑定到具体物体，且正确条目的检索与空间定位仍是独立瓶颈。该工作为对话接地的具身记忆指明了三个关键改进方向。
arxiv.reason: 具身智能体基准，属机器人/具身方向，仅评测层面沾LLM边

arxiv.title: ECHO: Efficient Causal Self-Recursion Beyond Auxiliary Multi-Token Prediction
arxiv.abstract: Existing Multi-token prediction (MTP) methods are auxiliary by design: the multi-horizon loss mostly trains modules attached to the backbone, and each added horizon costs another module and another pass. We propose Efficient Causal Self-Recursion (ECHO), which removes both costs. The backbone's own final layer predicts every horizon, so the supervision lands on the parameters that generate the next token, and Dynamic Depth Sampling (DDS) keeps deeper horizons affordable by drawing the training depth with probabilities that decay along depth. Future prediction thus becomes part of the autoregressive objective rather than a task attached to it, and the gains follow on both sides of it. In pretraining, added depth converts into downstream accuracy where auxiliary modules saturate, concentrating on reasoning and code at half the MTP training overhead of training every depth. At inference, the pretrained model is its own drafter: it drafts beyond the depth it was trained for, and keeps its draft-target alignment on the open-ended, high-entropy generation where post-hoc drafters lose theirs. The advantage survives a doubled token budget, a repeated pretraining run, and supervised finetuning.
arxiv.titleZh: ECHO：超越辅助式多token预测的高效因果自递归
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有多token预测（MTP）本质上是辅助任务：多horizon损失主要训练挂在主干上的模块，每增加一个horizon就多一个模块、多一次前向。ECHO让主干自身的最后一层预测所有horizon，使监督直接落在生成下一token的参数上，并用动态深度采样（DDS）按随深度衰减的概率抽取训练深度，把全深度训练开销降到MTP的一半。预训练中，增加深度在辅助模块已饱和处转化为下游准确率提升，集中于推理与代码任务；推理时模型自任drafter，可超出训练深度起草，并在开放式高熵生成上保持draft-target对齐，而事后drafter在此处会失准。该优势在双倍token预算、重复预训练与SFT后依然成立。
arxiv.reason: MTP与自投机解码结合，命中预训练与推理效率方向

arxiv.title: BanglaBBQ: A Bias Benchmark for Question Answering in the Bangladeshi Context
arxiv.abstract: This paper introduces BanglaBBQ, a question-answering bias benchmark designed to capture stereotypes grounded in the Bangladeshi context, in both Bangla and English. Following KoBBQ and PakBBQ, BanglaBBQ adapts the original Bias Benchmark for Question Answering (BBQ) by classifying its templates into three groups: directly translated (DT), modified to align target groups or contexts with Bangladesh (TM), and removed when deemed unsuitable for the Bangladeshi context (SR). This process retains 140 templates across six categories, comprising 76 DT and 64 TM templates. Five newly authored (NA) categories, based on stereotypes common in Bangladeshi society, are then added: marital status, age and political perception, regional origin, educational background, and mental-health status. Native Bangladeshi annotators judged all 466 newly authored templates, and 372 were retained because a strict majority of English annotators identified the intended target and rated the attitude as common enough. Each newly authored template is linked to a documented source and a verbatim quote from it. Each evaluated template also has a counter-stereotypical version of its disambiguated context. The dataset was evaluated using two open-weight models (Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B) and two closed models (GPT-4.1-mini and Gemini 2.5 Flash). All four lean towards the stereotyped person when the context is ambiguous, in both languages, and the effect of language differs by model, so English results do not predict behaviour in Bangla. On the adapted BBQ templates, both Qwen3 models are also less accurate when the context contradicts a stereotype than when it confirms it. On the newly authored templates, the closed models follow counter-stereotypical evidence almost perfectly, and all four models are more biased on the templates that annotators validated than on those they rejected.
arxiv.comment: 13 pages. Data and code: https://github.com/SummitAnthony/BanglaBBQ-benchmark
arxiv.titleZh: BanglaBBQ：一个孟加拉国语境下的问答偏见基准
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有BBQ偏见基准难以覆盖孟加拉国社会语境，该工作按直译、改写、删除三类策略筛选出140个模板，并新增婚姻状况、年龄与政治认知、地域出身、教育背景、心理健康五类本地化模板，由孟加拉国母语标注者审核，466条新增模板中保留372条，每条附文献来源、原文引用及反刻板对照版本。在Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B、GPT-4.1-mini与Gemini 2.5 Flash上，四种模型在上下文歧义时均偏向刻板印象对象，语言效应因模型而异，英文结果无法预测孟加拉语表现；Qwen3在上下文与刻板印象相悖时准确率低于相符时，闭源模型在新增模板上几乎完全遵循反刻板证据。可作为低资源语言与文化本地化偏见评测的参考范式。
arxiv.reason: 属于benchmark评测方向，但语种与文化语境较偏门，分量有限

arxiv.title: Paired-Outcome Learning for Selective Spacecraft Attitude Capture under Torque Limits
arxiv.abstract: Torque-limited spacecraft attitude capture requires adapting the maneuver speed to uncertain braking authority. Faster settings can reduce average tracking error while worsening individual maneuvers, making selective modification of an existing controller a baseline-relative learning problem. A paired-outcome method combines three mechanisms: physically interpretable continuation policies with different speed envelopes, separate prediction of task failure and successful-pair tracking gains, and context-dependent rejection that executes the unchanged baseline. Complete paired simulations provide labels under common plant parameters and measurement seeds; training, validation, and calibration are separated by context. Basilisk experiments use 108 development contexts, 324 labeling rollouts, and 624 evaluation episodes across 48 test contexts, including disclosed post-freeze diagnostics. The selective controller reduces aggregate integrated attitude error by 4.67% relative to the branch baseline, with 17 improvements, 31 exact ties, and no observed regressions. Always using the fast alternative achieves a 4.81% reduction but worsens 11 cases. Gains occur in principal-axis, near-axis, braking-boundary, and selected noise/drift maneuvers; general coupled cases retain the baseline. Ablations show no additional aggregate benefit from branch commitment, active querying, or score subtraction. The evidence supports a restricted empirical trade-off between average improvement and individual regression, without establishing a closed-loop safety guarantee.
arxiv.titleZh: 力矩受限下选择性航天器姿态捕获的配对结果学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 力矩受限的航天器姿态捕获需让机动速度适应不确定的制动能力：更快的设定降低平均跟踪误差，却使个别机动变差，因此选择性改动已有控制器被建模为相对基线的学习问题。方法包含三部分：不同速度包络的延续策略、任务失败与成功配对增益的分别预测、按上下文决定是否回退到原基线的拒绝机制。在48个测试上下文的624个评估回合上，积分姿态误差相对分支基线降低4.67%，17次改善、31次持平、无退化；如果始终使用快速策略，误差虽降低4.81%，却使11例变差。结果显示平均提升与个体退化之间存在受限的经验折衷，但无闭环安全保证。
arxiv.reason: 航天器姿态控制属经典控制与航天工程，与LLM方向无关

arxiv.title: From Overparameterised Expressions to Parsimonious Models: Fisher-Geometric Pruning for Symbolic Regression
arxiv.abstract: Genetic programming symbolic regression (GPSR) often returns expressions that are larger than necessary, with dormant branches and finely tuned algebraic configurations that fit sampling noise. Existing complexity-control strategies, such as multi-objective size-accuracy search or information criteria embedded in the fitness function, act on syntactic representations during model search. We introduce Fisher-Geometric pruning (FGP), a post-hoc model-reduction framework that acts on fitted models and can complement these techniques. FGP combines local information geometry at the maximum-likelihood solution with explicit compatibility tests for interpretable parametric boundaries. A taxonomy of parametric directions separates local sensitivity from proximity to reducible boundaries, enabling the treatment of unidentifiable directions and reductions through zero constraints, asymptotic limits, and signed parameter identifications. Candidate reductions are realised by symbolic contraction and refitting, then accepted only when their cross-validated predictive risk remains within a prescribed tolerance. We evaluate FGP on controlled diagnostic problems and Pareto fronts generated by GPSR. Across both settings, FGP substantially reduces structural complexity while preserving, and often improving, out-of-sample accuracy. Comparisons with competing pruning strategies and ablations show that, by combining geometric screening, boundary compatibility, and predictive validation, FGP yields the most consistent joint gains in parsimony and generalisation.
arxiv.titleZh: 从过参数化表达式到简约模型：面向符号回归的 Fisher 几何剪枝
arxiv.summaryZh: 遗传规划符号回归常输出比所需更大的表达式，含休眠分支与拟合采样噪声的精细代数结构，而现有复杂度控制手段只在搜索阶段作用于语法表示。FGP 作为事后模型约简框架，在最大似然解处结合局部信息几何与可解释参数边界的相容性检验，用参数方向分类法区分局部敏感性与可约边界的接近程度，从而处理不可辨识方向，并通过零约束、渐近极限与带符号参数辨识实现约简；候选约简经符号收缩与重拟合实现，仅当交叉验证预测风险落在给定容差内才被接受。在受控诊断问题与 GPSR 生成的 Pareto 前沿上，FGP 大幅降低结构复杂度，同时保持甚至提升样本外精度，与竞争剪枝策略及消融实验相比在简约性与泛化的联合收益上最为稳定。
arxiv.reason: 符号回归的几何剪枝，与 LLM 后训练/Agent 主线无交集

arxiv.title: ReTRACE: Feedback-Guided LLM Agent in a Chemistry Harness for Retrosynthesis Planning
arxiv.abstract: Computer-aided retrosynthesis has advanced through single-step prediction, tree search and route scoring, but complex targets still require judgement over the whole route, where stereochemistry, functional-group compatibility, cost and greenness interact. Here we present \textbf{\mbox{ReTRACE}} (\textbf{RE}trosynthesis with \textbf{T}ool-orchestrated \textbf{R}easoning \textbf{A}nd \textbf{C}ontext-aware \textbf{E}vidence), an agent that places a large language model (LLM) in a chemistry harness that integrates molecular tools, complementary single-step prediction engines, a purchasable starting-material library, a route memory and a multi-criterion route evaluator. Routes are judged by a new metric that combines programmatic checks with adversarial LLM review, and its verdicts are compared with a synthetic chemist's. The agent learns continually from evaluator feedback during search, diagnosing weak routes and backtracking to revise them. With Claude Opus 4.8, at least one of the top 10 routes proposed by ReTRACE passed the audit for 87.4\%, 95.0\% and 86.7\% of targets on the three benchmarks. Two prospective wet-lab syntheses show that ReTRACE route proposals can be converted into executable procedures after expert revision.
arxiv.titleZh: ReTRACE：化学 harness 中由反馈引导的 LLM Agent 用于逆合成规划
arxiv.summaryZh: 复杂目标分子的逆合成规划需综合判断立体化学、官能团兼容性、成本与绿色性，单步预测与树搜索难以胜任。ReTRACE 将 LLM 置于化学 harness 中，集成分子工具、多个互补的单步预测引擎、可采购起始原料库、路线记忆与多准则路线评估器，并让 Agent 在搜索中依据评估反馈持续学习、诊断弱路线并回溯修正。新评估指标结合程序化检查与对抗式 LLM 审阅，其判定与合成化学家对照。以 Claude Opus 4.8 运行，三个 benchmark 上分别有 87.4%、95.0%、86.7% 的目标在前 10 条路线中至少一条通过审计；两项前瞻性湿实验表明路线经专家修订后可转为可执行流程。
arxiv.reason: LLM Agent 加工具编排有看点，但属化学垂直应用

arxiv.title: Are We Evaluating VLM Token Pruning Right? Looking Beyond Accuracy and Token Count
arxiv.abstract: Visual token pruning aims to reduce inference cost while preserving the capabilities of the original VLM. Yet existing evaluations rely on aggregate task accuracy and retained token count as proxies for pruning quality and actual efficiency. We reveal two limitations: 1) Aggregate accuracy can obscure whether a pruning method truly identifies critical visual tokens; many examples remain solvable under arbitrary token removal and models can exploit textual shortcuts when visual evidence is degraded. 2) Retained token count is an unreliable proxy for efficiency, as identical token budgets can incur different end-to-end costs depending on where and how pruning is performed. Consequently, comparisons based on aggregate accuracy and retained token counts fail to recover the global performance-efficiency Pareto frontier across methods. We introduce PAA-Bench, a plug-and-play evaluation framework for existing benchmarks, to evaluate whether pruning succeeds through meaningful token selection and whether this success translates into real speedup. To determine when token choice actually matters, we propose Random-Pass@k to measure how often an example remains correct under random pruning, enabling comprehensive evaluation across different levels of selection difficulty. To compare efficiency fairly, we introduce Preservation-Constrained Speedup (PCS) to report the maximum end-to-end speedup each method achieves under a shared preservation target. Experiments across 8 methods, 3 VLM backbones, and 9 benchmarks show that stronger token compression does not necessarily yield greater speedup, method differences widen on examples where token selection matters, and efficiency rankings change with the preservation target.

arxiv.titleZh: 我们评估 VLM 视觉 token 剪枝的方式正确吗？超越准确率与 token 数量的审视
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有视觉 token 剪枝评测依赖聚合任务准确率与保留 token 数，二者分别掩盖了剪枝是否真正选中关键视觉 token、以及相同 token 预算下端到端开销差异的问题，导致无法还原方法间全局的性能—效率 Pareto 前沿。为此提出即插即用评测框架 PAA-Bench，用 Random-Pass@k 衡量样本在随机剪枝下仍正确的频率以区分 token 选择难度，并用 Preservation-Constrained Speedup（PCS）在统一保真目标下报告最大端到端加速比。在 8 种方法、3 个 VLM 骨干、9 个基准上的实验显示：更强的 token 压缩未必带来更大加速，方法差异在 token 选择真正起作用的样本上被放大，效率排名随保真目标变化。该工作为 VLM 推理效率研究提供了更可靠的评测口径。
